infrastructure_project_type.label: Infrastructure project type
infrastructure_project_type.value: Pipelines, power plants, solar and wind farms, electrical transmission and distribution, communications networks, water and sewer treatment facilities, data centers

public_private_client_mix.label: Public / private client mix
public_private_client_mix.value: Predominantly private-sector utility, energy, pipeline and communications customers, with some water and sewer work

heavy_equipment_model.label: Heavy-equipment model
heavy_equipment_model.value: Largely owned construction fleet, supplemented by leased equipment

fixed_price_cost_overrun_exposure.label: Fixed-price / cost-overrun exposure
fixed_price_cost_overrun_exposure.value: Mix of fixed-price, unit-price and time-and-materials contracts, with some cost-overrun exposure on fixed-price work

concession_operating_commitments.label: Concession / operating commitments
concession_operating_commitments.value: Build-only construction and engineering contracts; no concession or operating commitments

notes: Backlog, fixed-price mix and equipment model are not on the website; values from general knowledge are qualitative.
